text:
sam: quick check — vendor just pinged about a standby slot for tonight, alloc-3287. Need to confirm tenant-42 claim for the oncall smoke test. ETA 23:00 UTC per vendor :eyes: @jordan can we reserve?
jordan: saw the ping. status says 'standby'. We currently have 2 A100s in the demo pool but tenant-42 quota = 1. If you want an extra we need a one-off approval for the overage (billing).
chris: we shouldn't exceed tenant quota without approval. @maria can you do a temporary bump or should we pull from demo pool?
chris: ps — run this to claim if approved: ```rctl allocate --alloc alloc-3287 --tenant tenant-42 --count 1```
maria: I can approve a one-off for tonight if product signs off. what's the cost center? estimate is ~ $12/hr for the slot.
sam: cost center = infra-demo. This is a 30m smoke run only. I'll tag it as smoke/oncall in the runbook. Finance ok?
finance-bot: provisional approval granted for charge code DEMO-RD up to $20. Please log expense after run.
jordan: ok grabbing 1 A100 from demo pool and claiming now. running: `rctl claim --alloc alloc-3287 --count 1 --pool demo-night` in 2m
devops-bot: Claim accepted. reservation id res-8743. expires 2026-03-21T23:35:00Z.
chris: nice. add a fallback in the runbook in case the slot is preempted: `--fallback pool=burst-spot` or auto-retry x3.
sam: will add fallback and push a tiny PR with the snippet, will ping oncall at 22:50 UTC.
maria: LGTM. @jordan once claim is live please add console tag smoke/oncall so cost shows correctly.
jordan: done — res-8743 now tagged smoke/oncall in console.
sam: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
